DELL.headline: DELL Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Strong AI Demand Aids Revenue Growth
DELL.description: Dell Technologies reported Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings of $7.04 per share, beating estimates by 41.65%, with revenues surging 58% to $46.97 billion driven by record AI server orders of $60.9 billion. The company raised fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $192 billion and expects $74 billion in AI server revenues, with ISG revenues jumping 89% year-over-year to $31.78 billion.

DELL.headline: Dell's $95 Billion Backlog Answers the AI Question
DELL.description: Dell Technologies posted record quarterly revenue of $46.97 billion (58% YoY growth) with non-GAAP EPS of $7.04 (203% YoY growth), significantly beating consensus estimates. The company booked a record $60.9 billion in AI server orders and exited with a $95 billion backlog. Dell raised full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $192 billion from $167 billion, implying 69% growth. Gross margins expanded 260 basis points to 20.9%, disproving concerns that AI servers carry structurally lower margins

DELL.headline: Apple's Shares Rise 2.6% as John Ternus Takes Over as CEO
DELL.description: John Ternus officially took over as Apple's CEO on September 1, succeeding Tim Cook after nearly 15 years. The leadership transition boosted Apple shares by 2.6%. Ternus, who joined Apple in 2001 and led hardware engineering, faces pressure to accelerate the company's AI strategy while maintaining its product ecosystem. Cook transitioned to executive chairman focusing on government relations. The market welcomed the succession, viewing it as providing continuity while enabling innovation.

DELL.headline: Dell Reports Record Results: AI Momentum Remains Robust
DELL.description: Dell Technologies reported record revenue of $47.0 billion, up 58% YoY, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand. The company raised FY27 revenue guidance by $25 billion to $192 billion. AI server orders hit a record $60.9 billion with a $95 billion backlog, providing strong visibility. Adjusted EPS of $7.04 exceeded consensus estimates by 40%, and the stock maintains a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

DELL.headline: Stock Market Midday, Sept. 1: Stocks Slide on Global Bond Sell-Off
DELL.description: U.S. stock markets declined midday on September 1, 2026, as a global bond sell-off pressured equities amid geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and inflation concerns. The S&P 500 fell 0.42%, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.69%, and the Dow Jones declined 0.42%. Rising Treasury yields and the prospect of a Federal Reserve rate hike weighed on investor sentiment, particularly impacting technology stocks. Communication and consumer defensive stocks led gains, while Apple rose on CEO succession

FRVO.headline: Google Just Locked Up the Largest Geothermal Power Deal Ever Made.
FRVO.description: Fervo Energy signed a massive geothermal power deal with Google to supply 396 MW of electricity from its Cape Station project in Utah starting in 2028, with an option to expand to 1 GW by mid-2030. The agreement addresses the critical need for reliable, clean power to support AI data center expansion and validates Fervo's enhanced geothermal technology model.

FRVO.headline: Fervo Energy Company (FRVO) Faces Investor Scrutiny Amid Post-IPO Transmission Curtailment Revelation – HBSS
FRVO.description: Fervo Energy Company's stock plummeted 16% after revealing on its Q2 2026 earnings call that it expects temporary transmission infrastructure shutdowns affecting its Cape Station project, reducing 2027 revenue estimates to $60-80 million. Shareholders rights firm Hagens Berman has opened an investigation into whether Fervo adequately disclosed this curtailment risk in its IPO documents filed in May 2026.
